author: Jeff Kenyon
reply: Jeff, thank you. Two right away is a good start, and the big one was clearly doing most of the damage. Rake out the mounds and the lawn should recover quickly. Call us if any fresh ones show up.

author: santosh kumar
reply: Thank you, Santosh. We appreciate the five stars, and we're here if the moles ever come back.

author: William Henshaw
reply: William, that's exactly how it should feel. Years of fighting moles yourself wears you out, so we're glad you can hand it off and enjoy the yard again. Thanks for trusting us with it.

author: Melody Deisher
reply: Melody, thank you. Three moles caught and a lawn that looks great is a good result. I'll pass this along to Cory and Robert. We appreciate you taking the time.

author: Lewis Henry
reply: Lewis, thank you, and thanks to your friend for the referral. Moles are hard to beat on your own, so you're in good company there. Glad we could get it handled quickly.

author: Mary Suhadolnik
reply: Mary, thank you. Glad we caught the buggers. We appreciate the recommendation and the kind words.

author: Chris Breiland
reply: Chris, thank you for laying out the whole process. Catching the active moles is step one, and the weeks of monitoring after are what make sure new ones don't move in behind them. Glad you're mole free, and call us if that changes.

author: Mary Jeffers
reply: Mary, thank you. Showing up on time and keeping you informed matters to us as much as the trapping, so we're glad it came through. We appreciate the recommendation.
